# ITipJar
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/ITipJar.sol)

**Inherits:**
[ITipJarEvents](../events/i-tip-jar-events.md), [ITipJarErrors](../errors/i-tip-jar-errors.md)

**Title:**
ITipJar

Interface for managing tip streams and distributing accumulated tips


## Functions
### addTipStream

Adds a new tip stream


```solidity
function addTipStream(TipStream memory tipStream) external returns (uint256 lockedUntilEpoch);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`tipStream`|`TipStream`|The tip stream to add|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`lockedUntilEpoch`|`uint256`|The epoch until which this tip stream is locked|


### removeTipStream

Removes an existing tip stream


```solidity
function removeTipStream(address recipient) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`recipient`|`address`|The address of the tip stream recipient to remove|


### updateTipStream

Updates an existing tip stream


```solidity
function updateTipStream(TipStream memory tipStream, bool shakeAllFleetCommanders) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`tipStream`|`TipStream`|The updated tip stream data|
|`shakeAllFleetCommanders`|`bool`|If true, performs a global shake of all fleet commanders before updating|


### getTipStream

Retrieves a specific tip stream's information


```solidity
function getTipStream(address recipient) external view returns (TipStream memory);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`recipient`|`address`|The address of the tip stream recipient|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`TipStream`|TipStream struct with the recipient's tip stream details|


### getAllTipStreams

Retrieves all tip streams' information


```solidity
function getAllTipStreams() external view returns (TipStream[] memory);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`TipStream[]`|An array of all TipStream structs|


### getTotalAllocation

Calculates the total allocation percentage across all tip streams


```solidity
function getTotalAllocation() external view returns (Percentage total);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`total`|`Percentage`|The total allocation as a Percentage|


### shake

Distributes accumulated tips from a single FleetCommander

Redeems shares, distributes assets to recipients, and sends remaining to treasury


```solidity
function shake(address fleetCommander) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`fleetCommander`|`address`|The FleetCommander contract to distribute tips from|


### shakeMultiple

Distributes accumulated tips from multiple FleetCommanders

Calls shake() for each FleetCommander in the array


```solidity
function shakeMultiple(address[] calldata fleetCommanders) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`fleetCommanders`|`address[]`|An array of FleetCommander contracts to distribute tips from|


### pause

Pauses the TipJar, preventing shake operations


```solidity
function pause() external;
```

### unpause

Unpauses the TipJar, allowing shake operations


```solidity
function unpause() external;
```

## Structs
### TipStream
Defines a recipient's share of distributed tips


```solidity
struct TipStream {
    address recipient;
    Percentage allocation;
    uint256 lockedUntilEpoch;
}
```

**Properties**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`recipient`|`address`|The address that receives this stream's allocation|
|`allocation`|`Percentage`|The fraction of total tips allocated to the recipient, as a Percentage|
|`lockedUntilEpoch`|`uint256`|The epoch until which the stream cannot be modified or removed|
